summary: Ran /app/backend_test.py end-to-end against https://mint-app.preview.emergentagent.com. After fixing 2 trivial test-script issues (wrong hardcoded admin password 'TaskMint@2026' vs .env '9372@Altaf93', and missing /api/profile/mobile call before /api/withdraw which is now mandatory), 32/35 assertions pass (91.4%). Admin login, device login, /auth/me, banners, campaigns, links, withdraw-settings, full delete-user + cascade, reject/approve withdrawal with refund + admin_note, campaign approve/reject/delete + re-submit, and watch-earn flow (5/day) all work. 3 failures remain: (1) /api/links missing 'business_contact' (and 'telegram_contact') field on freshly seeded singleton — real backend seed bug; (2) and (3) backend_test.py asserts watch reward in [20,50] and 20/day limit, but server.py uses [50,100] reward and 5/day limit — test/PRD spec drift, not a backend bug.

critical.issue: Fresh-seeded app_links singleton (insert_one in seed_initial_data at server.py:1665-1672) does NOT include 'business_contact' or 'telegram_contact' keys. The preceding update_one migrations only patch pre-existing docs. Result: clients reading /api/links never get business_contact (returns only telegram, whatsapp, customer_support, privacy_policy, terms). Fix: add 'telegram_contact': '' and 'business_contact': '' to the seed insert_one dict.

minor.issue: Spec drift between PRD/backend_test.py (rewards 20-50, limit 20/day) and server.py (rewards 50-100, limit 5/day at server.py:837-848). Decide canonical spec and align one side. Backend behavior is internally consistent.

Endpoint now requires mobile_number to be set via /api/profile/mobile first (server.py:1122). The bundled backend_test.py did not call /api/profile/mobile, so t1 (which seeds a withdrawal for cascade-delete test) silently got a 400; test still passes because cascade-cleared assertions remain valid (no withdrawal to clean up). Added set_mobile() helper in backend_test.py for t2 to fix this. Not a backend bug, just a test-data prerequisite.

action_items: Fix seed_initial_data in /app/backend/server.py (~line 1665): add 'telegram_contact': '' and 'business_contact': '' to the app_links insert_one dict so fresh seeds include all keys returned by /api/links.

Decide canonical watch-earn spec: either update server.py to rewards=randint(20,50) and limit=20/day to match PRD/test, OR update PRD + backend_test.py to match current backend (50-100, 5/day). Currently they disagree.

Optionally: backend should consider tolerating absent mobile_number for first-withdrawal OR document /api/profile/mobile as a hard pre-req in /api/withdraw error message (already does) — but the bundled test script never set it, so update backend_test.py for t1 too if you want a full happy-path withdrawal seeded there.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1720 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers/ modules (auth, tasks, admin, wallet, withdraw, seed) for maintainability.
Seed logic for app_links has two divergent code paths (migration update_one + insert_one) that drift apart. Consolidate into a single 'ensure singleton with default fields' upsert.
Admin password is stored in plaintext via env var (ADMIN_PASSWORD). Acceptable for this app per existing design, but worth flagging.
updated_files: /app/backend_test.py (fixed admin password 'TaskMint@2026' -> '9372@Altaf93' to match /app/backend/.env; added set_mobile() helper and called it in test_reject_withdrawal before /api/withdraw)
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed; each test creates throwaway devices/users prefixed with deluser_/wd_/watch_/camp_a_/camp_b_. Admin uses fresh admin_dev_* device per run and promotes via /api/auth/admin-login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend env at https://mint-app.preview.emergentagent.com is healthy. Admin creds are 93altaff@gmail.com / 9372@Altaf93. backend_test.py is fixed to use the correct password and to call /api/profile/mobile before /api/withdraw. Remaining 3 failures are: (a) missing business_contact in /api/links (backend seed bug), (b)+(c) watch reward range and daily limit spec drift. Once main agent picks a canonical watch spec and patches seed_initial_data, re-run `python /app/backend_test.py` to confirm 35/35.
rca_of_issue: RCA — business_contact missing: In server.py seed_initial_data() the migration-style update_one calls (lines 1654-1661) precede the existence check (line 1664). On a fresh DB, no singleton exists yet, so both update_one calls are no-ops; then insert_one (lines 1665-1672) inserts only telegram/whatsapp/customer_support/privacy_policy/terms — telegram_contact and business_contact never get seeded. Reproduce: drop db.app_links collection, restart backend, GET /api/links — keys lack business_contact. Fix: include 'telegram_contact': '' and 'business_contact': '' in the insert_one dict (or restructure as a single upsert with $setOnInsert).
